summary: Ukrainian drones struck multiple Russian regions overnight including Lipetsk, Tula, Kursk, Belgorod, and Moscow oblast, while Russia launched a massive combined missile and drone attack on Kyiv involving ballistic missiles, Zircon hypersonics, and Geran-5 drones causing casualties. Ukrainian forces simultaneously hit a Russian electronic warfare station in Bryansk, a materiel depot in occupied Luhansk, and a command post in occupied Zaporizhzhia.
key_points: Ukrainian drones attacked Russian rear areas overnight causing explosions in Lipetsk, Tula, Kursk, Belgorod, and Moscow regions with St. Petersburg declaring a drone threat. (Source: @UkraineNow/84829)

Russia launched six ballistic missiles, three Zircon hypersonic missiles, and multiple Geran-5 drones at Kyiv killing one and injuring 22 including four children across six districts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77377, @mon1tor_ua/77383, @UkraineNow/84830)

Ukrainian forces struck a Russian electronic warfare station in Bryansk region, a materiel depot in occupied Luhansk, and a command post with UAV control point in occupied Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @UkraineNow/84844)
Russian attacks damaged energy infrastructure in three Ukrainian regions causing new power outages in six additional regions per the Energy Ministry. (Source: @UkraineNow/84835)
Kremlin declared readiness to resume trilateral talks with Ukraine and US in November, potentially in Abu Dhabi after November 10, focusing on post-war security. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23915)

High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region reported alongside six jet UAV groups from Orel and widespread Shahed/Geran-5 activity across northern and central Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77406, @eRadarrua/125588)

Ukraine secured centralized weapons procurement through NATO Support and Procurement Agency (NSPA) improving cooperation amid strained US relations per NSPA Operations Director Jacqueline Borsboom. (Source: @UkraineNow/84834)

Zelenskyy warned that losing Sloviansk and Kramatorsk could allow Russian advances to Dnipro and Pavlohrad, with Russia currently controlling 18-19% of Ukrainian territory. (Source: @UkraineNow/84842)

sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian drones struck multiple Russian regions overnight including Lipetsk, Tula, Kursk, Belgorod, and Moscow oblast, while Russia launched a massive combined missile and drone attack on Kyiv involving ballistic missiles, Zircon hypersonics, and Geran-5 drones causing casualties. Ukrainian forces simultaneously hit a Russian electronic warfare station in Bryansk, a materiel depot in occupied Luhansk, and a command post in occupied Zaporizhzhia. Russia attacked energy infrastructure in three Ukrainian regions causing power outages in six more, while the Kremlin signaled readiness for trilateral talks with Ukraine and US in November.

points: Ukrainian forces conducted overnight drone strikes on Russian territory hitting Lipetsk, Tula, Kursk, Belgorod, and Moscow regions with explosions reported and St. Petersburg declaring a drone threat. (Source: @UkraineNow/84829)

General Staff confirmed Ukrainian strikes on a Russian electronic warfare station in Bryansk region, a materiel depot in temporarily occupied Luhansk region, and a command-observation post with UAV control point in occupied Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @UkraineNow/84844)

Ukraine will procure weapons and ammunition centrally through NATO Support and Procurement Agency (NSPA) following improved cooperation with NATO amid worsening US relations per NSPA Operations Director Jacqueline Borsboom. (Source: @UkraineNow/84834)

Cabinet of Ministers is preparing new mobilization booking rules by end of week, removing provision on non-counting of deferred workers in quota calculations and creating a Coordination Center to verify justification of criteria. (Source: @UkraineNow/84838)

Zelenskyy stated Trump has leverage over Putin but may prioritize US energy prices ahead of Congressional midterms, while warning that loss of Sloviansk and Kramatorsk could open path for Russian advances to Dnipro and Pavlohrad. (Source: @UkraineNow/84837, @UkraineNow/84842)

Lviv Regional Council declared 2027 as year of Roman Shukhevych and UPA, drawing Polish condemnation and Ukrainian MFA calling the decision 'counterproductive' made without central government consultation. (Source: @UkraineNow/84822)

Russian forces launched a massive combined attack on Kyiv including six ballistic missiles, three Zircon hypersonic missiles, multiple Geran-5 drones, and regular Shaheds resulting in one death and 22 injuries including four children across six capital districts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77377, @mon1tor_ua/77383, @UkraineNow/84830)
Russia attacked energy infrastructure in three Ukrainian regions causing new emergency power outages in six additional regions according to the Energy Ministry. (Source: @UkraineNow/84835)

High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region reported with six jet UAV groups launched from Orel and extensive Shahed/Geran-5 activity from multiple directions including Chernihiv, Bryansk, Kursk, and Black Sea. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77406, @eRadarrua/125588)

Kremlin announced readiness to resume trilateral negotiations with Ukraine and US in November at technical level, potentially in Abu Dhabi after November 10, to discuss post-war security guarantees for both Russia and Ukraine. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23915)

Russian forces control approximately 18-19% of Ukrainian territory per Zelenskyy, with stated objectives including Zaporizhzhia and Mykolaiv beyond the immediate eastern front. (Source: @UkraineNow/84842)

Multiple Russian missile and drone launches tracked: ballistic threats from northeast, Zircons targeting Kyiv/Obukhiv, Geran-5 from Bryansk to Chernihiv, and jet UAVs from occupied Donetsk toward Pavlohrad and from Black Sea toward Mykolaiv/Odesa. (Source: @kpszsu/89461, @mon1tor_ua/77383, @mon1tor_ua/77407, @kpszsu/89470)

Zelenskyy warned that Russian capture of Sloviansk and Kramatorsk would create serious risks of further advances toward Dnipro and Pavlohrad, with Zaporizhzhia and Mykolaiv also identified as Russian objectives. (Source: @UkraineNow/84842)

Ukrainian forces struck a materiel depot in temporarily occupied Luhansk region and a command-observation post with UAV control point in occupied Zaporizhzhia region per General Staff report. (Source: @UkraineNow/84844)
Russian jet UAVs launched from occupied Donetsk region toward Pavlohrad district in Dnipropetrovsk region, with two jet Shaheds reported on this vector. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77407)
Two jet Shaheds launched from Dnipropetrovsk region toward Oleksandriia district in Kirovohrad region, indicating continued pressure on central-eastern Ukraine logistics. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77407)

Russian forces maintain ballistic missile threat from northeast direction with Iskander-M launchers in Bryansk region posing direct risk to eastern and central Ukrainian cities. (Source: @kpszsu/89461, @mon1tor_ua/77406)

Intense drone activity over northern Ukraine: six jet UAV groups launched from Orel region, multiple Geran-5 launches from Bryansk toward Chernihiv, and jet UAVs from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region past Slavutych. (Source: @eRadarrua/125588, @mon1tor_ua/77407, @kpszsu/89493)

Kyiv experienced multiple air raid alerts with ballistic missile threats (six Iskanders), Zircon hypersonic missiles (three), Geran-5 drones, and regular Shaheds entering Sviatoshynskyi district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77377, @mon1tor_ua/77383, @mon1tor_ua/77379, @mon1tor_ua/77401)

Chernihiv region saw high-speed target (1200 km/h) intercepted near Honcharivske, with three UAVs passing near Honcharivske and Geran-5 launches from Bryansk to Chernihiv district. (Source: @eRadarrua/125571, @eRadarrua/125602, @mon1tor_ua/77407)

Zhytomyr region tracked multiple UAV movements: two from Kyiv region toward Ovruch/Korosten, one toward Zviahel, and Geran-5 launch toward Rivne region Sarny district. (Source: @eRadarrua/125590, @eRadarrua/125602, @mon1tor_ua/77407)

Sumy and Kharkiv regions under jet UAV pressure from north and south with groups detected heading toward Kharkiv from both directions and reactive UAVs in Poltava region. (Source: @kpszsu/89442, @eRadarrua/125576, @mon1tor_ua/77408)

Jet UAVs launched from Black Sea waters toward Ochakiv in Mykolaiv region and toward Pivdenne, with additional Shahed on border of Mykolaiv and Odesa regions. (Source: @kpszsu/89463, @kpszsu/89470, @mon1tor_ua/77407)

Russian forces launched jet Shaheds from Odesa region toward Vinnytsia region Haisyn district (four UAVs) and regular Shahed from Odesa toward same district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77404, @mon1tor_ua/77408)
Zaporizhzhia city targeted by jet Shahed per monitoring data, while Ukrainian forces struck command post in occupied Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77408, @UkraineNow/84844)
Mykolaiv region air defenses engaged jet UAV from Black Sea toward Ochakiv, indicating continued Russian use of naval drone launch platforms. (Source: @kpszsu/89463)

Massive combined Russian air attack on 22.10.2026 included six ballistic missiles, three Zircon hypersonic missiles, multiple Geran-5 drones, and dozens of jet and regular Shahed UAVs across northern, central, and southern Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77377, @mon1tor_ua/77383, @mon1tor_ua/77379, @mon1tor_ua/77404, @mon1tor_ua/77407, @mon1tor_ua/77408)

Ukrainian drone strikes penetrated Russian air defenses reaching Lipetsk, Tula, Kursk, Belgorod, and Moscow regions with St. Petersburg declaring drone threat, demonstrating extended range and penetration capability. (Source: @UkraineNow/84829)

Russian jet UAV (Shahed/Geran-5) launches coordinated from multiple axes: Orel (6 groups), Bryansk, Kursk, occupied Donetsk, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Kirovohrad, Cherkasy, Poltava, and Black Sea. (Source: @eRadarrua/125588, @mon1tor_ua/77404, @mon1tor_ua/77407, @mon1tor_ua/77408)

Kyiv air defense engaged multiple threat types simultaneously: ballistic missiles, hypersonic Zircons, Geran-5, and Shahed-136/131 variants with at least one Shahed penetrating to Sviatoshynskyi district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77377, @mon1tor_ua/77383, @mon1tor_ua/77379, @mon1tor_ua/77401)

Electronic warfare station in Bryansk region destroyed by Ukrainian strike, potentially degrading Russian air defense and drone guidance capabilities in western border area. (Source: @UkraineNow/84844)
